name: compact-navigation-evidence
goal: The compact project agent and fixed navigation requirements produce fresh screenshots and assertions bound to the tested revision and build in agent-creation and desktop-renderer.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: compact-agent.spec.ts and fixed-navigation.spec.ts were unmapped and wrote screenshots only to /tmp; bind them into agent-creation and desktop-renderer with revision- and build-bound captures. Product UI and spec workloads unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: scenario-capture.ts records a viewport capture only where the scenario declares the state and exact size; new required states compact-agent, fixed-navigation with build desktop-renderer; wrapped tests and scope mappings added.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Spec assertions unchanged; each spec calls scenarioCapture once after its final assertions. scenarioCoverage negatives reject a wrong revision and a missing phone capture.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
Exercise the affected UI path and capture fresh evidence.
steps.evidence: CheckRunService, candidate worktree at base 8329ae14: compact-agent-ui 5/5, creation-ui 7/7, fixed-navigation-ui 3/3, ui-workspace 4/4; 7 fresh screenshots pass scenarioCoverage for build 033fe425; inspected.

steps.title: Function and component composers are distinct required states, so neither variant's capture can stand in for the other.
steps.evidence: compact-agent-functions and compact-agent-components each required at desktop and agent-phone; coverage fails when either variant's captures are dropped; wrong revision rejected; same 7 screenshots, byte-identical.
